task:
Fix a broken Deployment by rolling back to a working revision.

Context: A Deployment named 'api-new-c32' in namespace 'neptune' is broken because someone updated it with a non-existent image.

Setup (if Deployment does not exist, create it):
  kubectl create ns neptune 2>/dev/null || true
  kubectl create deploy api-new-c32 --image=nginx:1.19 -n neptune --replicas=2
  # Introduce the broken update:
  kubectl set image deploy/api-new-c32 nginx=ngnix:1.21 -n neptune  # typo: ngnix

Task:
  1. Investigate the broken Deployment:
     kubectl rollout status deployment/api-new-c32 -n neptune
     kubectl rollout history deployment/api-new-c32 -n neptune
     kubectl describe deploy api-new-c32 -n neptune

  2. Identify the broken revision (the one with the typo image)

  3. Roll back to the last working revision:
     kubectl rollout undo deployment/api-new-c32 -n neptune
     # OR rollback to specific revision:
     kubectl rollout undo deployment/api-new-c32 --to-revision=1 -n neptune

  4. Confirm all pods are Running:
     kubectl rollout status deployment/api-new-c32 -n neptune
     kubectl get pods -n neptune

Verify:
  kubectl get deploy api-new-c32 -n neptune -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image}'
  # Expected: nginx:1.19 (original working image)
hints: kubectl rollout history  shows all revisions with change-cause
kubectl rollout history --revision=2  shows details of specific revision
kubectl rollout undo  reverts to the PREVIOUS revision
kubectl rollout undo --to-revision=N  reverts to a specific revision
detailed_hints: Check current image: kubectl get deploy api-new-c32 -n neptune -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image}'
Roll back: kubectl rollout undo deployment/api-new-c32 -n neptune
Monitor: kubectl rollout status deployment/api-new-c32 -n neptune
kubectl get pods -n neptune  -- all pods should be Running after rollback

validators.command: kubectl get deploy api-new-c32 -n neptune -o jsonpath='{.metadata.name}'
kubectl get deploy api-new-c32 -n neptune -o jsonpath='{.status.availableReplicas}'
